name: uniform
description: Drive a Uniform DGX Spark platform from the session: deploy models, watch progress, read logs and GPU metrics.

platform_url.title: Platform URL
platform_url.description: Base URL of the Uniform control service, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:18180, or an SSH tunnel to a shared DGX Spark.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: The platform's UNIFORM_API_TOKEN. Leave empty when the platform runs without authentication.
